title: Virtua Tennis
text:
Virtua Tennis (Power Smash in Japan) is a 1999 tennis arcade game created by Sega AM3. It was later ported to Dreamcast in 2000, and for Microsoft Windows in 2002.

Gameplay
The player competes through tennis tournaments in an arcade mode. For the home console market the game was expanded with the introduction of the campaign mode.
